_comment:
Property rules for Vault FILES (iProperties), keyed by the file's Category Name. Used by scripts/check_file_properties.py — type a file name (e.g. CD-001659.iam) and every rule below runs against that file's properties. Reloaded on every run, so edits take effect immediately.

This is the file-side twin of item_property_rules.json. The rule engine is shared (check_item_properties.evaluate_rule), so the schema is identical, but the property NAMES differ because files and items expose different properties:
    item 'Number'                -> file 'File Name'
    item 'Title (Item,CO)'       -> file 'Title'
    item 'Description (Item,CO)' -> file 'Description (File)'
    item 'Units'                 -> (no file equivalent; dropped)
    (file-only)                  -> 'CAD Category', 'Material Finish'

Description rules follow the 'Vault PDM – Item Description' standard (rev A): lowercase keyword nouns only — no dimensions, no material, no ISO/DIN/standard numbers, no project/customer names. Standard numbers belong in the Title.

'CAD Category' is gated per rule set with allowed_values matching the category itself, which enforces 'the CAD category agrees with the Vault category' without needing a cross-property rule type.

ALWAYS REQUIRED, in every category: State, Revision, Project, Engineer, Engr Approved By, Source — plus Vendor on every part and assembly, and Designer on everything EXCEPT assemblies (the design credit lives on the child parts). 'Engr Approved By' additionally forbids the value 'NOT REVIEWED' everywhere, because that string means the review has not happened. tests/test_check_file_properties.py locks all of this in, so dropping one of them from a category fails the suite rather than silently weakening the gate.

NOT GATED: 'Title' and 'CAD Category' are declared with required:false so their values still appear in the report, but they never fail a file.

Each property may declare any of: required (bool), allowed_values (list), forbidden_values (list), pattern (regex, fullmatch), forbidden_patterns (list of regex, re.search), min_length (int), max_length (int), description (str), required_unless ({property, matches_pattern}).

Assembly - Engineering.description: Inventor assemblies (.iam) designed in-house. Source = Make; sign-off + project required. Material lives on the child parts, not the assembly.

Title.description: Reported for reference, not gated. ISO / DIN / standard numbers belong here when there are any.

Description (File).description: Lowercase keyword nouns only per Vault PDM – Item Description standard. No dimensions, materials, standards, or project/customer names.

Vendor.description: Who supplies it. Required on every part and assembly.

Engr Approved By.description: Must name an approver. 'NOT REVIEWED' is never acceptable — it means the review has not happened.

Designer.description: Not gated on assemblies — the design credit lives on the child parts.

Part - Engineering.description: Inventor parts (.ipt) designed in-house. Source = Make; Material spelled out; sign-off + project required.

Description (File).description: Lowercase keyword nouns only per Vault PDM – Item Description standard.

Material.description: Spell out the material — no abbreviations. Use 'Stainless Steel 304' not 'SS304', 'Aluminum 6061-T6' not 'AL6061', 'Polycarbonate' not 'PC'. Grade designators (304, 6061-T6, etc.) are fine; the leading material noun must be a full word.

Vendor.description: Who supplies it — the outside shop for machined parts, the stock supplier otherwise. Required on every part.

Engr Approved By.description: Must name an approver. 'NOT REVIEWED' is never acceptable — it means the review has not happened.

Part - Purchased.description: Bought parts modelled or downloaded as .ipt. Source = Buy; Vendor + Vendor Number required unless the Title names a published standard (ISO/DIN/etc.).

Title.description: Reported for reference, not gated. Still drives the Vendor Number exemption below when it names a published standard.

Description (File).description: Lowercase keyword nouns only per Vault PDM – Item Description standard.

Vendor.description: Who you buy it from. Required on every part — a published standard still has a supplier.

Vendor Number.description: The supplier's own part number. Exempt when the Title names a published standard — a generic ISO screw has no single supplier SKU.

Engr Approved By.description: Must name an approver. 'NOT REVIEWED' is never acceptable — it means the review has not happened.

Drawing - Engineering.description: Inventor drawings (.idw / .dwg). No Material or Source of their own — they inherit from the model they document. Sign-off + project required so released prints are attributable.

Description (File).description: Lowercase keyword nouns only per Vault PDM – Item Description standard.

Engr Approved By.description: Must name an approver. 'NOT REVIEWED' is never acceptable — it means the review has not happened.

Part - Content Center.description: Inventor Content Center parts — library fasteners and standard hardware. Identity + supplier tracked; in-house sign-off fields are not expected.

Vendor.description: Who you buy it from. Required on every part — a library standard still has a supplier.

Vendor Number.description: The supplier's own part number. Exempt when the description names a published standard.

Engr Approved By.description: Must name an approver. 'NOT REVIEWED' is never acceptable — it means the review has not happened.

_unchecked_categories._comment: Categories deliberately left without a rule set. Files in these categories report SKIP (no rule set) rather than a misleading PASS. Add a block under `categories` above to start gating one.
